future_check: Keep at least one exact canonical-profile hit per band in the strict profile gate; investigate before accepting any zero-support band.
rationale: The first correct repair still underrepresented canonical scale, especially in hard mode. Even sample indices now cycle over the five canonical height-width profiles; odd indices retain the broader banded size curriculum, and explicit dimensions always win.
summary: Anchor half of default draws to exact canonical input dimensions in every band.

future_check: Replay self_check against all five canonical inputs after any component-separation refactor.
rationale: An early repair assumed all blobs were mutually separated, but canonical examples contain differently coloured cells that touch orthogonally while still forming distinct monochromatic components. The contract therefore uses monochromatic 4-connectivity and only forbids intrusion into the selected bbox.
summary: Different-colour components must not be required to have a zero-cell moat.

future_check: Widen key_column to the full grid only after dependency-aware relative override cases are supported.
rationale: The current override matrix detaches relative domains such as 0..w-1 from the referenced width. Because the minimum width is 10, 0..9 is the widest unconditional exact domain that every independent override case can satisfy honestly.
summary: key_column is intentionally capped at 0..9 although wider grids exist.

future_check: Keep all named rival disagreement counts positive in every band whenever shape scheduling changes.
rationale: Every normal draw places the selected component between a smaller and a larger distractor; four-blob draws also include an equal-size distractor, and every selected bbox has an internal zero. This prevents size, modal-colour, and solid-bbox shortcuts from fitting the generated curriculum.
summary: Make the bottom-row key necessary rather than merely compatible with the answer.

future_check: Require a zero-finding exact override matrix whenever any AXES declaration changes.
rationale: The prior metadata mixed dead singleton axes, an ignored palette axis, and negative fixtures in the ordinary texture domain. The replacement surface is grid_h, grid_w, palette_kind, n_blobs, key_column, and target_size; observe_overrides recovers all six exactly.
summary: Declare only six exact, output-recoverable axes and reject unknown overrides.

future_check: Re-run selected-authority sync and execution parity if either canonical program_solution or target_code changes.
rationale: Canonical program_solution and task-local target_code are exact-text identical and hash to the declared RULE_HASH. Historical raw_code is textually different but solves every canonical pair and passes execution parity, so no shared Racket source patch is warranted.
summary: Pin the generator to the selected canonical/target rule without rewriting archival raw_code.
